parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to use rstantools::rstan_package_skeleton to create a very simple package with precompiled stan code. I read the guidelines. Alas, I cannot figure out how to access the precompiled model to call rstan::sampling(mod = myprecompiled_model..). 

Can you tell me what am I missing, or point me in the right direction? I'm able to compile my very simple package, and I can see the stan code in stanmodels$model1.  But, sampling(stanmodels$model1 ...) does not work.

I saved my code on bitbucket in case that helps. The function stanlm.R calls sampling on line 66.

Thanks a lot,

Ignacio
